pluginId.description: Registered visualization ID when type is plugin; configuration remains in the saved dashboard document.

dataKind.description: Normalized input kind for a plugin visualization.

savedQueryId.description: Saved query referenced by this widget, including failed resolution; see savedQueries for its captured ETag when available.

annotationSavedQueryId.description: Saved query referenced by the widget annotation source, including failed resolution.

freshness.description: Age of the primary series' latest valid returned sample relative to the selected range end. This is not underlying scrape or ingestion health. Unknown means no usable returned sample.

threshold.description: A configured Single value visual band for the last valid displayed sample, not an alert or service-health verdict. A matched band names a status (ok, info, warning, critical or unknown), a six-digit hex color override, or both. The first band also applies below its boundary. A color override, when present, replaces the status mark for that band. A missing latest observation is reported separately on the signal.

end.description: Optional end-time column for interval annotations.

kind.description: Normalized query kind, including empty and failed results.

providerId.description: Resolved provider ID when the caller is authorized to resolve the provider; omitted when its lookup fails.

state.description: Data availability, not health. A source-limited response without usable observations is partial rather than definitively empty; populated limited responses remain ok and disclose providerTruncated.

truncated.description: Some data was omitted from this bounded signal or its compact summary; check providerTruncated and the specific preview flags to distinguish source limits from presentation limits.

providerTruncated.description: The provider response hit a source limit or was otherwise partial. State can still be ok when a bounded query succeeded; do not treat returned counts as source-wide totals.

seriesTruncated.description: The compact output omitted fetched series; distinct from providerTruncated.

seriesReturned.description: Series in the bounded provider response, not source-wide cardinality. Present for successful metric queries, including zero.

seriesOmitted.description: Fetched series omitted from the compact summary; independent of source limits disclosed by providerTruncated.

returned.description: Rows in the fetched provider page, not a source-wide total.

rows.description: Preview tuples in column order; null remains missing and zero remains zero.

duplicateObservations.description: Additional returned observations sharing a valid timestamp in this series, including missing-valued observations. Some visualizations reject duplicate timestamps and require query aggregation. Statistics include all valid samples.

last.description: Latest valid finite observation; check tailMissing and lastAt before treating it as the latest recorded sample.

mean.description: Arithmetic mean of all finite returned observations with valid timestamps, including duplicate timestamps; not time weighted or a source-wide average. Omitted when no finite observations exist.

firstAt.description: Earliest recorded timestamp, including missing values, in Unix milliseconds.

lastAt.description: Latest recorded timestamp, including missing values, in Unix milliseconds.

tailMissing.description: The latest recorded observation has no finite value; last refers to an earlier valid observation when present.
